lead_story.topic: Seahawks defend Super Bowl title in NFL Kickoff Game despite losing Sam Darnold on opening drive — Drew Lock leads comeback, Drake Maye throws 3 INTs in 4th quarter
lead_story.headline: Drew Lock > Drake Maye

tweets.text:
Drake Maye has two multi-interception games in his last 30 starts.

Both were against the Seahawks.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba vs Patriots:

8 REC
122 YDS
1 TD

His first receiving touchdown in a Week 1 game.

Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald said the team got "great news back" on Sam Darnold and doctors do not believe his quarterback’s hip is fractured.

An MRI on Thursday is expected to tell the team more.
Also, give the Seattle secondary credit. No Nick Emmanwori or Ty Okada, Coby Bryant and Riq Woolen gone, and they pick Drake Maye off three times, including the game-winner.
I knew Drake Maye didnt drink beer but I thought hed at least be able to take a a few shots

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [opener]: Reader already knows this is the Super Bowl LX rematch from 7 months ago. New tonight: Seahawks lost Darnold on the FIRST DRIVE (hip injury, CT scan inconclusive, MRI Thursday), Macdonald said 'great news back' / no fracture. Patriots led 10-0 at half. Drew Lock came in cold and led the comeback. Drake Maye threw THREE interceptions in the 4th quarter—all in the final 7 minutes, including the game-ender in the endzone down 3. A.J. Brown (ankle) ruled out in 3rd quarter in his Patriots debut. JSN: 8-122-1. Rhamondre: 23 touches (more than any game last season). The stat: Maye has two multi-INT games in last 30 starts—both against Seattle. The narrative: championship DNA—Seahawks won with their backup QB after losing their starter on the opening drive of the season. Research the history: how rare is it for a defending champ to win their opener after losing their starting QB in the first quarter? Name the others. That rarity IS the story. PFTCommenter: 'I knew Drake Maye didnt drink beer but I thought hed at least be able to take a few shots.' SharpFootball: 'Drake Maye's last 5 games: 7 TD : 11 turnovers (7 INTs, 4 fumbles lost), 24 sacks taken, 143 yards lost on sacks, 6.6 yds/att, 5.6 net yards/att.' The game was ugly—Patriots ran into the #1 run defense on first down all night (1.9 YPC), kept welcoming 3rd & long. Romeo Doubs: 3 targets, 1 drop, 1 INT, 0 catches. Lock quote post-game: 'Alright, let's get ready for four minute. Alright, let's get ready for two minute. Oh my gosh they're still throwing it. Pick this off way to go Jobe. Holy cow. We did it. Here we are. 1-0.' Drew Lock is now LEADING THE NFL IN PASSING YARDS. The Seahawks' +/- problem: Emmanwori and Okada were out (big absences for secondary that lost Bryant and Woolen). Eight penalties for 88 yards against Seattle, one took a TD off the board, one gave the Pats the ball at the Seahawks 2. Maye quote: 'It was just unacceptable. I vow to myself to be better.' The meme layer: Drew Lock undefeated against the Patriots. The Dianna Russini jokes (see ATL). The ghetto_gronk AJ Brown jokes. The 'Drake Maybe' jokes. The Cooper Kupp one-handed grab. The feeling: we waited 7 months to watch Drew Lock play football. This was the worst NFL game of the year and we got it out of the way pretty quickly. But somehow it was still awesome and competitive. What a sport.
